9. The respondent no. 2 stated that she has settled with the petitioner no.1 out of her own free will and without any force, fear or coercion and she is living happily with the petitioner no. 1 along with their children in the matrimonial home as such, she does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no.0184/2019 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.
